many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u022/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d2b1ada0.py')
p.write_text('''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    """Map the most common/background color to 0 and all other cells to it."""
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[0 if value == background else background for value in row] for row in grid]
''')
print('saved',p.exists(),'bytes',p.stat().st_size)
